headline: Callahan's Passage Roars Back as Weathered Expanse Toll Mounts
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse remains the war's fiercest ground, and the map there has shifted since our last edition: the Wardens now count five holds to the Colonials' four, the region's earlier ruins made good, while sixty-four base events in a day and sharply climbing losses — Colonial casualties near three hundred an hour in the latest reading, Warden above four hundred — center on Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Callahan's Passage, silent in our previous report, has sprung back to life: two events in the past two hours, the last at the moment of filing, with casualties accelerating steeply while the Wardens hold nine of ten posts. Mooring County likewise resumed around mid-morning, its tempo quickening across an eleven-to-one Warden front. The Stlican Shelf still churns — twenty-four events, the Wardens back to four of nine with the earlier ruin repaired — though its newest exchange came before ten. Fisherman's Row, once loud, has been quiet since 07:44. The Nevish Line's casualty pace keeps rising though its eight-base front stands unchanged. It is day 404; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
